title: ExamLeaf Learning Signal v2 (aggregate only)
description: One aggregate cell the platform sends back, keyed by ids the sidecar already exports (Architecture §9.7 Learning signals; CE-117: interface level-2, operation level-3+; added 15 Oct 2026). A signal never edits the graph: it opens a proposal (raise MIS priority, add a SIM, author a new MIS, or queue an F15 doubt) that goes through S4 and GA-Graph, and writes a signal_proposal ledger row.
$comment: No learner identifiers (CE-117, 15 Oct 2026): no learner, device, account, session, school or location id, no free text written by a learner, and no timestamps finer than the window; additionalProperties is false at every level so none can be added. Intake rejects a record whose cohort_size is below min_cohort_size; the minimum is set by counsel under O-3, stricter for safety/ac0 and safety/ac1, and recorded with its policy ref. doubt_cluster_text is a paraphrase written by the platform, never a quote. Commercial-term lint (CE-L1/RD-49; CE-26, CE-70; updated 15 Oct 2026): CI rejects, case-insensitively, any match of (price|pricing|paid|is_free|free_|premium|entitle|subscri|sku|paywall|unlock|monetis|monetiz|revenue|discount|coupon|tier|destination_resource|cta_destination|funnel|purchase_|checkout_|product_id|offer_|trial_|utm_|campaign_|affiliate_|activation_code|storefront) applied to every object key at every depth (including REN fields keys), every required entry, pattern key and enum or const value. Exempt: the editorial fields series_position, flagship and demo_kind, which carry no commercial meaning.

share.description: Decimal string in [0, 1] (hash canon: measured quantities are decimal strings).

min_cohort_size.description: The threshold applied, from the O-3 policy for this safety_class.
